why: Wholesale distributors sell to other businesses (restaurants, shops, pharmacies). They need tiered pricing, large-quantity discounts, receivables/credit book and B2B invoicing (ETA).
operator: The wholesale distributor manages bulk inventory, customer credit accounts and ETA e-invoices. Their day is price tiers, outstanding receivables and compliance with ETA invoicing rules.
entities: Distributor (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
Customer (id, distributorId, name, phone, creditLimitPiasters, creditUsedPiasters, paymentTerms, isB2B, status, repAssigned)
Product (id, distributorId, sku, nameAr, nameEn, category, unitPricePiasters, costPiasters, taxRate, unit (box,pack,litre), minOrderQty, maxOrderQty, status, locationShelf)
PriceTier (id, productId, minQty, maxQty, discountPercent, isActive)
Receivable (id, customerId, amountPiasters, dueDate, status, createdAt, lastPaymentAt, notes)
B2BInvoice (id, saleId, etaSigned, qrCode, sealHash, status, issuedAt, notes)
PurchaseOrder (id, supplierId, status, lines, expectedAt, totalPiasters)
Staff (id, distributorId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
units: box, pack, crate, litre, tonne, piece
batches: No : wholesale carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Receivables have due dates not expiry dates
special: The core structures are the price tier system (min qty / max qty / discount), the receivable tracking with due dates and the B2B invoice with ETA signing and QR code. Tiered pricing by volume is the key differentiator.
screens: Product catalogue: grid of products with name, price per unit, min/max order qty, price tier badge
Product detail: full info, all active price tiers, cost, min/max qty
Customer account: credit limit, credit used, payment terms, status, rep assigned, receivables list
Price tier manager: add/edit tier (minQty, maxQty, discount%), set active, compute discounts
Receivable tracker: list of outstanding receivables, due dates, aging, receive payment, mark paid
B2B invoice: generate ETA-compliant invoice with QR code and seal hash, sign, send to customer
Purchase order: receive from supplier, update stock, record cost
Cash register: scan SKU, apply price tier discount, tender payment, print receipt with invoice
Staff shift: clock in/out, customer load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : inventory, pricing, customers, invoices, reports, billing
Sales rep: manage customers, create price tiers, approve receivables, generate invoices
Cashier: scan items, apply price tier discount, tender payment, print receipt
Accountant: receivables aging, invoice verification, ledger export
reports: Sales by day and hour: revenue per period, peak hours
Price tier performance: which tiers are active, how much volume each tier drives
Receivables aging: total outstanding, by due date bucket, collection rate per period
B2B invoice volume: invoices issued, paid, outstanding per period
Customer credit: total credit used vs limit, top customers by volume
integrations: ETA e-invoice signer (server-side) for generating QR code and seal hash
Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and invoices
WhatsApp deep link for customer receivable notifications and invoice copies
onboarding: Distributor basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial product list: the starting catalogue with SKU, prices and price tier structure
Price tier scheme: the min/max qty and discount levels the distributor uses
Customer setup: the first B2B customer with credit limit and payment terms
First week plan: add first product, set first price tier, first customer, first invoice
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the price tier system and role templates.

tasks.title: Add product catalogue with price tier badges
tasks.brief: Build the product catalogue: grid of products with name, price per unit, min/max order qty, price tier badge. Done when the catalogue loads and displays items with price tier badges correctly.
tasks.done: When product catalogue displays live data with price tier badges

tasks.title: Add price tier manager
tasks.brief: Build the price tier screen: add/edit tier (minQty, maxQty, discount%), set active, compute discounts. Done when the tier is saved and discounts apply correctly at sale.
tasks.done: When price tier manager works end-to-end with discount computation at sale

tasks.title: Add customer account with credit and receivables
tasks.brief: Build the customer screen: credit limit, credit used, payment terms, status, rep assigned, receivables list. Done when the customer is saved and credit used updates correctly.
tasks.done: When customer account works with credit tracking and receivables list

tasks.title: Add receivable tracker with due dates and aging
tasks.brief: Build the receivable screen: list outstanding, due dates, aging buckets, receive payment, mark paid. Done when the receivable is saved and aging computes correctly.
tasks.done: When receivable tracker works end-to-end with aging computation

tasks.title: Add B2B invoice generator with ETA signing
tasks.brief: Build the invoice screen: generate ETA-compliant invoice with QR code and seal hash, sign, send to customer. Done when the invoice is generated with correct ETA fields and the QR code is valid.
tasks.done: When B2B invoice generator works end-to-end with ETA signing and valid QR

tasks.title: Add cash register with price tier discount
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan SKU, apply price tier discount, tender payment, print receipt with invoice reference. Done when the sale applies the correct tier discount and receipt prints.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end with price tier discount

tasks.title: Add receivables aging report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing total outstanding, by due date bucket, collection rate per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When receivables aging report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add B2B invoice volume report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing invoices issued, paid, outstanding per period. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When B2B invoice volume report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add customer credit report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing total credit used vs limit, top customers by volume. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When customer credit report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial wholesale setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: distributor basics, initial product list, price tier scheme, customer setup. Done when the flow completes and the distributor appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and distributor is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes customer and receivable records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
ETA invoicing without proper spec sign-off can violate tax law
Credit extended without clear limits and terms can violate consumer protection law
